name: OpenStreetMap administrative boundaries
attribution: Geographic placement derived from © OpenStreetMap contributors, ODbL 1.0.
coverage: Supporting administrative geography for library coordinates; institution facts retain their original sources.

notes: Supports region and area placement only. Does not establish present operation, a visitor address, or personal verification. Original Wikidata records and coordinates are preserved. Boundary evidence and reporting-code matches are retained in the repair report.
